description: RiskFactor is a data resource listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Vendor Data Resources > Resilience and Natural Hazards", published or maintained by as named on firststreet.org. Provided by the First Street Foundation, this tool enables users to understand properties' environmental risks from flooding, wildfire and extreme heat. The tool communicates historic events, current risks, and future projections for properties based on peer-reviewed research.
